text:
Rina (PM): Planning thread: EU opt-in A/B for new ranking model. Requirements: customers must be able to opt into variant A/B, three enterprise exemptions, and minimal latency regressions. Proposal below.

Evan (Eng): Idea: do an A/B (50/50) for a stabilization window, then ramp winners. But prefer progressive weights: 10/10/80 (control/variant/hold) where 'hold' = no switch for exempted VIPs. Run for 72h then pick winner.

Carlos (SRE): We need concrete infra gates. Set emergency rollback triggers: p95 > baseline + 120ms sustained for 2 intervals OR 5xx rate > 1% for 15m. Also auto-fail if queue depth > 200 for >5m.

Tess (Solutions): Add an `exempt_customers` tag. We already have tickets from 4 customers; only 3 will be honored as negotiated. Need an admin flow to add/remove exemptions and log audit trail.

Nika (CS): Confirmed — the 3 VIPs want to be excluded unless they explicitly opt-in. They also want a pre-ramp webhook 48h before each major flip.

Rina (PM): Good. Flag name: `eu_model_ab_v1`. Variants: `control`, `candidate`. Default: control for everyone except opt-ins and exemptions. Admin-only endpoint `POST /admin/flags/eu_model_ab_v1/exempt` and `POST /admin/flags/eu_model_ab_v1/optin`. Tess, can you own the admin UX?

Tess (Solutions): Yep. Will add endpoints and a Console table with `customer_id`, `status`, `added_by`, `reason`. ETA EOD next Wednesday.

Evan (Eng): Routing: use shard-aware routing so customer sessions persist. Implement sticky cookies/headers for A/B assignment. Store assignment in `assignment_store` with TTL 30d. Also ensure fallback route to `control` if candidate instances are degraded.

Carlos (SRE): Circuits: 1) if candidate pool CPU % > 85% for 10m -> divert new candidate traffic to control. 2) If candidate 5xx > 0.7% for 2 windows -> auto-evict candidate and send alert to #eng-oncall and #product. 3) Production fallback priority: control -> last-successful-variant -> regional-legacy.

Sam (Data): Quality measurement: we'll run blind A/B evals on a seeded prompt set (3k prompts). Compute win-rate and average BLEU + semantic similarity. Gate: candidate must not lose more than 1.5% win-rate vs control. We'll also ingest human feedback tags from CS for the VIPs.

Rina (PM): Time windows: 1) Preflight shadow (48h) with telemetry hooks but no user assignment. 2) 10% split (sticky session shard) for 24h. 3) 50/50 for 72h. 4) If pass, 80/20 candidate-favored for 24h. 5) Flip. Each step requires explicit owner sign-off or automated gates.

Evan (Eng): Example rollout config snippet: ```json
{
  "flag":"eu_model_ab_v1",
  "variants":["control","candidate"],
  "exempt_customers":[],
  "steps":[
    {"type":"shadow","duration":"48h"},
    {"type":"split","weights":[90,10],"duration":"24h"},
    {"type":"split","weights":[50,50],"duration":"72h"},
    {"type":"split","weights":[20,80],"duration":"24h"},
    {"type":"flip","default":"candidate"}
  ]
}
```

Tess (Solutions): We'll ensure the exemptions API returns audit logs in CSV and supports bulk import. Also add a `notify_url` hook for customers wanting pre-ramp notices.

Nika (CS): We'll prepare the 48h notice template and the opt-in consent flow. VIPs require manual confirmation before being enrolled.

Carlos (SRE): Runbook: include exact command to flip back: `curl -XPOST /admin/flags/eu_model_ab_v1/override -d '{"action":"force_control","rollout_id":"<id>"}'` and the Console kill-switch location. Any auto-evict must create an incident and link `rollout_id`.

Sam (Data): I'll publish a dashboard: A/B lift, p50/p95, cost delta, BLEU, semantic-similarity, and human flags. Also create an alert rule: if semantic-similarity drops > 2% AND p95 delta > 80ms -> page #product-engineering.

Evan (Eng): Note: warm caches before moving from 10% -> 50% — require at least 70% cache hit rate on prefixes for candidate pool. If not met, hold ramp and extend window.

Rina (PM): Comms: Marketing wants a short EU changelog and a knowledge base article describing opt-in process. Lee (Marketing) not in thread yet but will loop in.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout plan `eu_model_ab_v1` shadow start 2026-04-05T08:00Z by Evan.

Tess (Solutions): FYI — exemptions bulk CSV template: `customer_id,company,contact,added_by,reason`. Will attach to docs PR.

Rina (PM): Action items: Evan -> implement sticky assignment + PR for flag config; Carlos -> add circuit rules + runbook; Tess -> exemptions API + Console row + docs; Sam -> dashboards & alerting; Nika -> customer comms. Check-in in 36h.

Evan (Eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/flags/pull/945 (includes assignment_store & rollout config).

Tess (Solutions): Docs draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/flags/eu_model_ab_v1 (WIP).

Rina (PM): Thanks — if no objections we'll start shadow on Monday as scheduled. :white_check_mark:
